justifications.scope_discipline: git diff base..9e339f1db touches exactly nine paths: query_builder.py, paths/parallel.py, code/graph_* ops, base/reset.py, cli/discover/paths.py, the three test files and the evidence fragment; every one is inside the run manifest's declared write_paths, and nothing outside them is touched.
